scripts.dev: concurrently -n ui,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter ui dev" "uv run --directory api uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n ui,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter ui lint" "uv run --directory api ruff check ."
scripts.format: concurrently -n ui,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter ui format" "uv run --directory api ruff format . && uv run --directory api ruff check --fix ."
scripts.typecheck: concurrently -n ui,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter ui typecheck" "uv run --directory api pyright ."
